The '''two step''' is a small brown snake of the [[Aiel Waste]].

==Description==
The name two step comes from the strength of its venom which can kill a victim before they can move two steps. This snake was described to [[Rand al'Thor]] by [[Aviendha]] while she was teaching him about the Aiel Waste.{{ref/book|4|48}}
